question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

LGS : QHX :: NDP : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

First and last letter of given word is added with +5.

Middle letter of given word is added with +1.

LGS : QHX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44ab62bdf8a7db7781e68c6f0500321c29aeb8b7b10c64d11114d4b6f4f8152b.png] 

Similarly,

NDP : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2549040f4036cf68705f0aa4476e0790e7d7b95c32f5b6289db6b86188521b31.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SEU".**
